results.title: Business Development Representative
results.description:
At Champion , we believe that the biggest growth catalyst doesn’t lie outside, but within. It’s not about more, but about untapping the potential from opportunity that already exists — from within your champions and yourself.
As a product and a company, we’re set on creating deeper partnerships with organizations and their champions so each and every person can do more, together. Our mission is to help organizations activate their happiest customers as advocates — turning advocacy into a true growth engine.
But “ Champion ” isn’t just about business growth. It represents individual and professional growth. We’re building a company where every team member is empowered, celebrated, and supported to become their best.
As an early-stage startup, you’ll be part of the starting lineup — helping build the foundation for Champion ’s GTM success alongside the founding team.
About the Role
Champion is looking for a motivated Business Development Representative (BDR) to be the first point of contact with potential new customers. You’ll engage with Customer Marketing Leaders, Chief Marketing Officers, and GTM executives about driving growth through customer advocacy, while working closely with our Account Executives (AEs) and VP of Marketing to develop and execute a coordinated go-to-market motion.
This is more than a traditional BDR role — it’s an opportunity to reimagine how outreach is done. At Champion , we believe the best growth comes from human connection, customer-centricity, empathy, and curiosity. You’ll help pioneer a motion that replaces transactional outreach with meaningful engagement — where every conversation builds trust, not just pipeline.
Your goal is to develop relationships with prospects in our Ideal Customer Profile and convert them into high-quality opportunities through authentic outreach, warm introductions, re-engagement of past conversations, and by driving attendance to Champion ’s in-person and virtual events. You’ll partner closely with our AEs to identify and develop opportunities and with our VP of Marketing to align outreach with campaigns, content, events, and broader marketing initiatives .
We will also invest heavily in your professional growth and Champion YOU!! You’ll be invited to join the Pavilion GTM community to learn from your peers, receive professional coaching, and have direct mentorship from the CEO and COO.
What You’ll Do

Prospect and Engage: Lead outreach to prospective customers through thoughtful, human-centric communication across email, social, and events.

Build Relationships: Develop authentic connections with customer marketing, advocacy, and GTM leaders across mid-market and enterprise accounts.

Create Pipeline: Identify new opportunities through warm introductions, event engagement, and outbound campaigns, aligning closely with our CEO and COO.

Market Intelligence: Research target accounts to identify organizational priorities, customer programs, and advocate signals that align with Champion ’s mission.

Marketing Collaboration: Support campaigns, events, and launches — turning engagement into meaningful conversations.

Process Evolution: Help build and redefine the SDR motion — tools, messaging, metrics, and playbooks. You’ll leave your fingerprint on how we scale and build a human-centric framework for driving growth.
Own Results: Set and achieve measurable goals for outreach, meetings booked, and pipeline created, while ensuring quality stays high.

What You’ll Bring

A self-starter mindset — resourceful, proactive, and driven by results.

Genuine interest in customer marketing, GTM innovation, and AI in B2B.

Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to connect quickly and authentically.

Deep empathy and human-centric communication — you understand that great selling starts with listening, curiosity, and trust.

Curiosity and confidence to engage executives with purpose and thoughtfulness.

Ability to learn quickly, stay organized, and thrive in a fast-moving environment.

Perseverance: You push through challenges with consistency and optimism, always finding a way forward.

Compensation & Benefits

Base Salary: $65,000–$70,000

On-Target Earnings (OTE): $75,000–$85,000

Equity: Early-stage equity grant

Benefits:

Healthcare, dental, and vision coverage for employees

Monthly equipment stipend for laptop, monitor, and tools

Flexible time off policy

Values We Live By
Go On Offense We’re a culture of experimentation, speed, and adaptation — we play to win.
Be Better Than Yesterday In our arena of growth, every day is a new game.
Get Curious, Not Critical We ask questions before making assumptions, driving deeper learning and greater impact.
Check Your Ego at the Door We collaborate openly, welcome feedback, and celebrate great ideas — no matter where they come from.
One Team, One Goal We believe and understand that we all impact the collective goal.

results.title: Head of Business Development - Logos
results.description:
Logos is a movement supporting the development of the decentralised web. Logos technologies lay the foundations for a freer internet upon which communities can evolve into network states. Each protocol in the Logos stack seeks to empower its users while upholding civil liberties and fundamental freedoms.

About Logos :
Logos is building the technology and community required for a more sovereign, decentralised world.
Our technology stack spans decentralised infrastructure, communications and storage, with a focus on privacy, censorship resistance and permissionless systems. We work at the intersection of protocol development, Web3 infrastructure and ecosystem building.
We’re looking for a Head of Business Development to own and drive business development across Logos , while leading a team of two.
This isn't a traditional sales role. We're looking for someone who is deeply embedded in the Web3 infrastructure ecosystem, with a strong understanding of how decentralised networks operate and experience working with/launching privacy-focused protocols. Crucially, you'll have been through a mainnet launch and understand what it takes to build the partnerships, ecosystem and infrastructure relationships required both in the lead-up to launch and as the network scales post-mainnet.
The role:
As Head of Business Development, you will lead the development and execution of strategies to grow the Logos ecosystem. You will be responsible for establishing strategic partnerships, designing and executing growth strategies and building any relevant commercial relationships.
You'll identify where Logos technology can solve real problems, build relationships with protocols and infrastructure providers, and work closely with our technical teams to turn opportunities into integrations and long-term partnerships.
You'll also manage and develop a team of two, providing direction and prioritisation while remaining highly hands-on yourself.
A core part of the role is being able to operate credibly with technical stakeholders. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should understand the technology stack well enough to have substantive conversations with protocol teams, founders and engineering leaders without relying on someone else to translate the technology for you.
Responsibilities:

Develop and execute Logos ’ BD and partnership strategy, building strategic relationships ahead of mainnet and driving ecosystem growth and adoption through expanded distribution channels post-launch.

Identify the ecosystems, protocols, infrastructure providers and applications where Logos technology can deliver the greatest value and bring users and volume to Logos network

Build a focused pipeline of high-value opportunities rather than pursuing partnerships for their own sake.

Establish clear priorities and success metrics for BD activity, owning the performance of BD goals against budget.

Own opportunities from initial identification through technical evaluation, negotiation, integration and ongoing relationship management.

Build technically meaningful partnerships:

Develop relationships across the Web3 infrastructure ecosystem, including wallets, centralised exchanges, on/off-ramps, oracles, indexers, DeFi protocols and aggregators, multisigs and other infrastructure providers, with a particular focus on those actively engaged in the privacy ecosystem.

Identify opportunities for integrations, deployments, ecosystem partnerships and adoption of Logos technology.

Understand prospective partners’ technical architecture and identify how Logos can complement their technology stack through its privacy capabilities, while attracting privacy-focused applications and protocols to build on the Logos ecosystem.

Work with technical teams on both sides to move opportunities from conversation to implementation.

Represent Logos credibly with founders, protocol leads, ecosystem teams and technical decision-makers.

Understand the technology:
You should be comfortable discussing concepts such as:

L1s, L2s and modular blockchain architectures

P2P and decentralised networking

Nodes, validators and network operators

Consensus and distributed systems

Decentralised storage and messaging

RPC and blockchain infrastructure

Wallet and application infrastructure

Token and network incentive models

Testnets, mainnets and network launches

Privacy-preserving and censorship-resistant technologies

You don't need to write production code, but you need genuine technical curiosity and enough depth to understand what we're building, why it matters, and how it can be used by others.
Lead the team:

Manage, mentor and develop an existing team of two BD contributors.

Set priorities and ensure the team is focused on the opportunities most likely to create meaningful adoption.

Establish a disciplined approach to pipeline management, ownership and follow-through.

Support the team on complex partnerships and negotiations.

Create accountability without introducing unnecessary processes or bureaucracy.

Remain hands-on with strategically important relationships and opportunities.

Work across Logos :

Partner closely with protocol, engineering, product, ecosystem and communications teams.

Bring market and partner feedback back into the organisation to help inform product and ecosystem priorities.

Translate technical capabilities into clear propositions for different partners and use cases.

Help technical teams understand the commercial and strategic context behind potential integrations.

Ensure partnerships result in tangible outcomes rather than announcements alone.

Required skills:

Significant experience in Web3, blockchain or decentralised infrastructure.

Strong understanding of the technical architecture of blockchain networks and Web3 infrastructure.

Experience in business development, ecosystem development, strategic partnerships or a closely related role.

Evidence of building partnerships that resulted in real integrations, adoption, users, network activity or revenue.

Existing relationships across the Web3 infrastructure ecosystem.

Ability to communicate effectively with highly technical stakeholders.

Strong commercial judgement and the ability to distinguish strategically valuable opportunities from noise.

Experience managing or mentoring a small team.

Comfortable operating autonomously in a remote, highly technical organisation.

A builder mentality; you enjoy taking opportunities from an initial idea through to something that actually exists.

We'd be especially interested in people who have worked within privacy focused ecosystems in areas such as:

Privacy focused L1 or L2 ecosystems

Decentralised networking projects relating to messaging, storage and or Privacy tools and applications

Wallets

Experience in Open-source protocols is a must

Hiring process: Interview with our People Ops team
Interview with Artem (IR Lead) & Rahul (BD)
Task
Interview with Kaushal (EcoDev Team Lead)
Interview with Co-founders, Jarrad & Carl
We occasionally use cognitive tests and/or personality tests to gain insight into candidates' suitability with our org. The results provide an additional data point for us when making our hiring decisions. The steps may change along the way if we see it makes sense to adapt the interview stages, so please consider the above as a guideline.
Compensation:
The expected compensation range for this role is negotiable, dependent on how we assess your skills and experience throughout our interview process. We are happy to pay in any mix of fiat/crypto

Bizmoni is seeking a Senior Genexus Developer to help design, build, and scale the technology behind our AI-powered super app. In this role, youll lead full-stack development from concept to deployment, ensuring seamless functionality, responsive performance, and secure user experiences across web and mobile platforms.

Develop front-end website architecture and user interactions on web pages.

Build back-end applications, create servers, and manage databases for functionality and performance.

Design and develop APIs to connect and optimize BizHubs services.

Ensure cross-platform optimization and mobile responsiveness.

Collaborate with designers to translate UI/UX concepts into functional products.

Manage projects end-to-end, from conception to final product delivery.

Conduct manual and/or automated functional, operational, and security testing.

Stay current with emerging technologies and Genexus updates.

Perform other duties as they may arise and be assigned by the Company.

Proven experience in Genexus Web/SD development, including Genexus Server, GAM, CI/CD, Data Modeling, and SQL Server (Genexus certification is a plus).

Strong skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern web frameworks.

Experience working with modularized KBs, Feature toggles, and code reusability.

Solid understanding of database technologies like MSSQLServer, MySQL, or Oracle.

Experience working with Teams, OpenVPN, RDP, and similar collaboration tools.

Strong organizational and agile project management skills (Kanban, Scrum).

Excellent communication, problem-solving, and attention to detail.

Proactive mindset, comfortable in fast-moving, collaborative environments.

What We Expect:

Flexible Hours: Meet deadlines and attend key meetings at your convenience.

Language Skills: Fluent in English; Spanish or Portuguese is a plus.

Self-Discipline: Comfortable working remotely and independently.

Results-Driven: Proactive, creative problem solver who delivers impact.

Tech-Ready: Personal computer with a camera and stable internet.

Equity-Based Compensation: Willingness to accept shares until our next funding round.

Time commitment: minimum of 16 hours per week.

What's in it for You:

Co-founder-level equity: Earn real ownership in a high-potential startup

Remote-first culture: Work from anywhere, on your schedule

Impact-driven mission: Build technology that supports real entrepreneurs around the world

Agile, collaborative team: Join an international team of doers, thinkers, and builders

Growth opportunity: Be part of the founding phase and influence core business strategy.

Why Join Bizmoni?
Join a high-energy, collaborative team and shape the future of AI-powered fintech. If you're passionate about innovation and growth, we'd love to meet you!
Before Applying, Ask Yourself:
1. Are you available to work at least 8-16 hours per week?
2. Are you open to equity-based compensation until our next funding round?
If your answer is 'YES', then we are happy to meet you!
Recruitment Process:
1. Interview with Technical Department Manager & TA Partner.
2. Practical assignment.
3. Offer (based on final positive feedback.)
Please send us your English CV stating the role you apply. Only shortlisted candidates are selected for the interview. Thank you.
